name: VOSIM
description: VOSIM (VOice SIMulation) pulse generator — bursts of squared sinewaves separated by silence, decaying in amplitude. A classic formant-synthesis primitive (Kaegi & Tempelaars, 1978) for vocal-like sounds. Each trigger starts a new burst of nCycles squared-sine cycles at freq, with each cycle scaled by decay relative to the previous one. From sc3-plugins VOSIMUGens.

inputs.name: trig
inputs.description: Trigger — starts a new VOSIM pulse on transition from non-positive to positive (only if no pulse is currently playing). Audio-rate triggering is sample-accurate

inputs.name: freq
inputs.description: Frequency of the squared sinewave inside each burst (Hz)

inputs.name: nCycles
inputs.description: Number of squared sinewave cycles per VOSIM burst — sampled when a new trigger arrives

inputs.name: decay
inputs.description: Per-cycle amplitude decay factor (each cycle's peak is decay times the previous one)
